newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Village lifts bid for Austereo.
newsitem.headline: Village lifts bid for Austereo.

text.p: Entertainment group and cinema operator Village Roadshow Ltd said on Wednesday it had lifted its takeover offer for radio group Austereo to A$2.55 a share from A$2.35 a share and extended the offer period to May 9.
The company said that the independent directors of Austereo now recommended Austereo shareholders accept the revised bid in the absence of any higher offer.

"While we consider our original offer of A$2.35 fair and reasonable, following discussions with the independent directors of Austereo and consideration of the valuation range assessed by Grant Samuels, we have decided to lift the offer to A$2.55 per Austereo share," Village Roadshow chairman Robert Kirby said in a statement.
Kirby said the company would make no further increases.
Village owned 52.83 percent of Austereo before it launched the bid in mid-March.
Austereo shares closed two cents higher at A$2.41 while Village shares added 14 cents to A$4.29.
